text:
Anya: Small UX bug from today's usability run: when "preview suppression" is toggled the table shows a ghost row that looks interactive. Users tried to click the kebab and got confused. Jordan: Yeah I saw that too. The hover affordances make it read like a real threshold. We should make preview rows non-interactive and visually distinct. Kevin: Prefer not to add more vertical chrome. Options: (A) dashed outline + 70% opacity + no hover states, (B) move preview out to a compact banner above the table, (C) inline collapsed accordion row that expands only in preview mode. My pick is A for density. Emily: If we remove interaction we must ensure keyboard and screen reader users can still access the preview summary. Can't leave them with inaccessible ghost content. Anya: Agreed. Jordan, can you prototype dashed row + small "Preview" pill at left and ensure it's non-focusable? Also propose wording for the pill: "Suppression preview" vs "Preview: suppression" vs "How suppression applies". Jordan: I'll mock that. Early copy thoughts: "Suppression preview" is concise, "How suppression applies" is more explicit for PMs. For the pill shorter is better visually. We can put more detailed copy in an aria-live summary. Kevin: Implementation notes: CSS: pointer-events: none for row, opacity .7, border-style: dashed #cbd2d9. But pointer-events:none will also block keyboard focus; we need a separate summary node that receives focus and is announced. Emily: Accessibility acceptance criteria: 1) When preview enabled, move focus to summary container with tabindex="-1" and role="status" + aria-live="polite" so screen readers announce, 2) Ghost rows have tabindex="-1" so keyboard skips them, 3) Tooltip and "+N more" popover must be reachable via keyboard and have proper roles (dialog/menu) and aria-modal/focus trap if it opens. Anya: Good. Also add a small "show full list" control when channels exceed 3. Otherwise the aria-live message will be a mile long. Use ellipsis and a "+N more" button that expands inline. Jordan: Mock notes: - dashed 1px #cbd2d9 - bg overlay rgba(220,223,226,0.07) - preview pill 10px height with label "Suppression preview" - tooltip text: "Shows how suppression would mute alerts for selected channels" - ghost row no pointer events - summary container pinned above table Kevin: Contrast check: with 0.07 overlay the text may fail AA. Recommend increasing overlay to 0.12 or darkening the dashed stroke to #b6bdc4. I'll run contrast checks and emit final hexes. Emily: For the pill copy final: product wants backend alignment on "Suppressed" but design prefers friendlier "Muted". Proposal: visible label "Muted until 2:00 PM" and smaller assistive text or tooltip that reads "Status: Suppressed" (screen readers should get both). Use aria-describedby to link the pill to the status text. Jordan: Example markup I'll prototype — summary region + pill and tooltip linking:
Suppression preview active: mutes alerts to Slack, Email for 1 hour.
status: suppressed
Jordan: For multiple channels use-case: "Suppression preview active: mutes alerts to Slack, Email, PagerDuty..." and append a "+2 more" button. The button opens an accessible dialog with list of channels. Anya: Nice. Also keyboard flow nit: when the preview toggles on and user had focus inside the table, pressing Tab should land on the summary (not on ghost row controls). So script should move focus to #suppression-summary and then the next Tab moves into the pill or "+N more" controls. Kevin: Edgecases: autosave vs temporary preview. If preview is temporary (not persisted) language must say "Preview" not imply it's active. If user confirms suppression the pill switches to persistent state and should read "Muted until..." (with aria-live announcement on change). We'll need microcopy for that state change. Emily: I'll draft a11y acceptance tests: 1) Screen reader announces preview summary within 1s of toggle, 2) Ghost rows are skipped in tab order, 3) Tooltip content is reachable and read on focus, 4) "+N more" dialog traps focus and returns focus to the toggle when closed. Jordan: I'll attach updated frames in Figma and include both copy variants. DesignBot: can you auto-generate the aria snippet for the prototype and a short checklist for devs? DesignBot: Generated snippet and checklist: ARIA snippet:
Suppression preview active: mutes alerts to Slack, Email for 1 hour.
Dev checklist: - [ ] Ghost rows: pointer-events:none; tabindex=-1; no hover tooltips - [ ] Summary: focus programmatically on toggle, role=status aria-live=polite - [ ] Pill: visible friendly copy + aria-describedby linking to hidden status text - [ ] "+N more": accessible dialog role=dialog, focus trap, ESC to close - [ ] Contrast: ensure dashed stroke >= AA for text + badge - [ ] Screen reader test on NVDA/VoiceOver with long channel lists Anya: Great. Action items: Jordan update Figma + include keyboard flow animation. Emily produce short a11y acceptance criteria doc. Kevin run contrast and supply final hex. I'll confirm final copy with PM (we'll likely show "Muted" in UI with tooltip showing backend "Suppressed"). :thumbsup:
